title: SmartWithdraw
description: SmartWithdraw is a lightweight Vault-integrated Minecraft economy plugin that allows players to convert virtual money into physical banknotes and redeem them back into their account.
body:
# 💰 SmartWithdraw

**A secure, lightweight, and modern physical currency system for Minecraft servers.**

SmartWithdraw allows players to convert their Vault economy balance into physical banknotes that can be traded, stored, gifted, and redeemed at any time. Notes are protected using Persistent Data Containers (PDC), support custom resource-pack textures, and integrate seamlessly with any Vault-compatible economy plugin.

---

# ✨ Features

✔ Withdraw money into physical currency notes

✔ Deposit notes back into your balance

✔ Right-click note redemption

✔ Stackable banknotes

✔ Secure PDC-based note validation

✔ Vault economy support

✔ CustomModelData texture support

✔ Resource pack integration

✔ Lightweight and optimized

✔ No database required

✔ Works on Paper, Spigot, and Purpur

✔ Supports Minecraft 1.21.x

---

# 📦 Supported Denominations

SmartWithdraw automatically converts withdrawn money into the following note values:

* ₹1 Note
* ₹10 Note
* ₹50 Note
* ₹100 Note
* ₹500 Note
* ₹2000 Note

---

# 🎮 Commands

## Withdraw Currency

Convert money from your balance into physical banknotes.

```text
/withdraw <amount>
```

Example:

```text
/withdraw 500
```

---

## Deposit Notes

Deposit all SmartWithdraw notes from your inventory back into your account.

```text
/deposit
```

---

## Help Menu

Display plugin information and supported note values.

```text
/smartwithdraw
/sw help
/smartwithdraw help
```

---

# 🔒 Security

SmartWithdraw uses Minecraft Persistent Data Containers (PDC) to verify every authentic banknote.

Each note contains secure metadata that cannot be replicated simply by renaming paper or editing item lore.

### Protected Against

✔ Fake lore notes

✔ Renamed paper exploits

✔ Item spoofing

✔ Manual lore editing

Only genuine SmartWithdraw notes can be redeemed or deposited.

---

# 🎨 Resource Pack Support

SmartWithdraw supports fully custom banknote textures using Minecraft's **CustomModelData** system.

Supported textures:

* note_1.png
* note_10.png
* note_50.png
* note_100.png
* note_500.png
* note_2000.png

Server owners may use the included default resource pack or replace it with their own custom pack at any time.

Future updates may also include redesigned and more aesthetically detailed banknote textures.

---

# 📦 Default Resource Pack

The default SmartWithdraw resource pack is available below.

### Download

https://download.mc-packs.net/pack/563df5e7d4583062832f7d1d3e716580f04d5511.zip

### Automatic Installation

To automatically send the resource pack to players when they join your server, add the following lines to your **server.properties** file.

```properties
resource-pack=https://download.mc-packs.net/pack/563df5e7d4583062832f7d1d3e716580f04d5511.zip
resource-pack-sha1=563df5e7d4583062832f7d1d3e716580f04d5511
```

Players will automatically download and apply the SmartWithdraw banknote textures when joining your server.

---

# ⚙ Dependencies

## Required

### Vault

Download Vault:

https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/bukkit-plugins/vault

---

## Compatible Economy Plugins

SmartWithdraw works with **any Vault-compatible economy plugin**, including:

* EssentialsX Economy
* CMI Economy
* XConomy
* EzEconomy
* JustAnEconomy

or any other economy plugin that supports Vault.

---

# 🖥 Supported Server Software

* Paper
* Purpur
* Spigot

### Minecraft Versions

* 1.21.x
* 1.26.x

---

# 📥 Installation

1. Install Vault.
2. Install a Vault-compatible economy plugin.
3. Place **SmartWithdraw.jar** inside your **plugins** folder.
4. Start or restart your server.
5. (Optional) Configure the included resource pack.
6. Enjoy realistic physical currency on your server.

---

# 📖 Example

Player Balance

```text
₹10,000
```

Withdraw

```text
/withdraw 2500
```

SmartWithdraw automatically creates

```text
₹2000 Note ×1
₹500 Note ×1
```

Players can then:

* Trade notes with other players
* Store notes inside chests
* Gift money physically
* Redeem notes instantly using right-click
* Deposit all notes using `/deposit`

---
